purpose: List GW008 Nexus mapping rows whose nexus_view is shared by multiple competition keys
sql: SELECT m.mapping_id,m.competition_key,m.sm_country,m.competition_group,m.sm_action,m.sm_division,m.nexus_view FROM `IMC Competition Nexus Mapping` m JOIN (SELECT nexus_view FROM `IMC Competition Nexus Mapping` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' GROUP BY nexus_view HAVING COUNT(*)>1) d ON d.nexus_view=m.nexus_view WHERE m.game_world_id='GW008' ORDER BY m.nexus_view,m.competition_key
